description.value: NiNNiN Ramen House is a ramen-focused restaurant on Abbott Street in Vancouver's downtown area, offering indoor dining in a non-smoking environment. It operates without a drive-through, making it a sit-down destination for cyclists looking to refuel with a hot bowl of ramen after a ride.
